name: dsh-folder-permissions
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-session, per-folder read/write permissions with a web session tab to register and toggle them. Host half provides ctx.folderPermissions, a /folder-permissions slash command, pre-configured allow lists, a durable per-session grant store, and a loopback grants route; the client half adds a Permissions tab to the conversation view ring. An optional core patch (scripts/patch-core.mjs) makes the filesystem fence honor granted folders.
